data.one_liner: Simple, high-performance Flutter charts with smooth animations for bar, line, pie, and candle charts.
data.what_it_does: Provides a set of animated chart widgets for Flutter, supporting bar, group bar, candle, line, and pie charts. It renders charts using a layered architecture such as axes and data layers.
use_when: You need standard bar, line, pie, or candle charts with smooth animations.
You want simple chart configuration using a layered declarative approach.
avoid_when: You require complex, highly specialized financial or scientific charting features not covered by basic chart types.
You need active ongoing maintenance beyond basic updates.
strengths: Supports multiple chart types including candle and group bar charts.
weaknesses: Limited documentation and examples outside of the basic README and /example folder.
Fewer community resources compared to major charting packages like fl_chart or syncfusion_flutter_charts.

alternatives.name: fl_chart
alternatives.why_pick_it: Extremely popular and feature-rich charting library for Flutter with a wide community.

alternatives.name: syncfusion_flutter_charts
alternatives.why_pick_it: Enterprise-grade charting library with high performance and extensive chart types.
